# BizQuest Businesses-for-Sale Listings, Financials & Broker Contacts

BizQuest is a US marketplace for buying and selling businesses, franchises and commercial real estate. This actor turns its public listings into a clean, filterable dataset: asking price, cash flow, EBITDA, gross revenue, industry, location, broker contact, photos and — when you enable full details — the seller's complete write-up, facilities, financing notes and more.

Runs are cookieless and need no BizQuest account, login or API key. The actor reads the same public listing data a buyer sees, adds pagination and filters, and returns one row per business.

## What this actor does

- Searches BizQuest nationwide or by state, city/county URL, industry, listing type, keyword, asking price, cash flow, gross revenue, listing age and more
- Paginates automatically through results up to `maxItems` (the site exposes up to 10,000 listings per search)
- Deduplicates listings across pages and across multiple search URLs
- Optionally loads each listing's full detail page for the seller write-up, financials, facilities, broker profile, photo gallery and other fields
- Omits fields the source does not publish for a listing instead of writing `null` placeholders
- Accepts saved inputs from older versions of this actor without changes

## Two ways to search

**1. Paste BizQuest URLs.** Apply any filters on BizQuest.com, copy the search, category, state, city or individual listing URL, and paste it into `startUrls`. The actor follows the URL and paginates from the requested page.

**2. Use the filters.** Leave `startUrls` empty and combine `keyword`, `state`, `industry`, `listingType`, price/cash-flow/revenue ranges and the boolean filters. The actor builds the search for you.

You can use both: explicit filters are applied on top of each pasted search URL.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `startUrls` | array | – | BizQuest search, category, state, city or individual listing URLs |
| `keyword` | string | – | Words to match in the listing title and seller description |
| `state` | select | any | US state or `any` for nationwide |
| `industry` | select | any | One of 28 BizQuest industry categories |
| `listingType` | select | any | Established business, asset sale, startup, miscellaneous, real estate for sale/lease, or all real estate |
| `minPrice` / `maxPrice` | integer | – | Asking-price range in USD |
| `minCashFlow` / `maxCashFlow` | integer | – | Cash-flow / EBITDA range in USD |
| `minGrossRevenue` / `maxGrossRevenue` | integer | – | Annual gross-revenue range in USD |
| `listedWithinDays` | integer | – | Only listings first published within this many days |
| `establishedAfterYear` | integer | – | Only businesses established after this year |
| `sellerFinancing` | boolean | false | Only listings advertising seller financing |
| `realEstateIncluded` | boolean | false | Only listings including real estate in the asking price |
| `homeBased` | boolean | false | Only home-based businesses |
| `absenteeOwner` | boolean | false | Only absentee-owner businesses |
| `sbaApproved` | boolean | false | Only SBA-loan-approved listings |
| `priceReduced` | boolean | false | Only listings with a recent price reduction |
| `recentlyUpdated` | boolean | false | Only recently updated listings |
| `franchiseResales` | boolean | false | Only existing franchise resales |
| `noAskingPrice` | boolean | false | Only listings without a published asking price |
| `withoutImage` | boolean | false | Only listings without a photo |
| `coBrokering` | boolean | false | Only listings that allow co-brokering |
| `maxItems` | integer | 50 | Maximum listings to save (1–10,000) |
| `fetchDetails` | boolean | false | Load each listing's full detail page |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | – | Optional; the actor works without a proxy by default |

Older input names such as `startUrl`, `searchUrl`, `searchUrls`, `filterKeyword`, `filterLocation`, `filterPriceMin`, `filterCashFlowMin`, `filterListingAgeDays`, `includeDetails`, `includeListingDetails`, `enrichDetails`, `maxResults` and `results_wanted` are still understood.

In raw JSON, `industry` takes the category slug (for example `food-and-beverage-businesses-for-sale`), not the display name.

### Example: daily nationwide check

```json
{
  "maxItems": 3
}
```

### Example: California restaurants between $200k and $1M

```json
{
  "state": "CA",
  "industry": "food-and-beverage-businesses-for-sale",
  "listingType": "established-business",
  "minPrice": 200000,
  "maxPrice": 1000000,
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: franchises with seller financing and full details

```json
{
  "franchiseResales": true,
  "sellerFinancing": true,
  "fetchDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 25
}
```

### Example: paste a filtered BizQuest search

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.bizquest.com/businesses-for-sale-in-texas-tx/",
    "https://www.bizquest.com/restaurants-for-sale-in-california-ca/"
  ],
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

### Example: a single listing

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.bizquest.com/business-for-sale/established-laundry-business-with-existing-facilities/BW2579892/"
  ],
  "fetchDetails": true
}
```

## Output

Every row represents one business. Fields that BizQuest does not publish for a particular listing are simply absent from that row.

### Listing and price

- `listingId` — BizQuest listing ID, e.g. `BW2579892`
- `title` — listing headline
- `url` — canonical BizQuest listing URL
- `shortDescription` — teaser shown on the search card
- `askingPrice`, `priceLabel` — asking price in USD and as displayed
- `cashFlow`, `cashFlowLabel` — cash flow / EBITDA when disclosed
- `ebitda` — EBITDA when the source publishes it separately
- `grossRevenue` — annual gross revenue when disclosed
- `priceReduced` — whether the asking price was recently reduced

### Location and classification

- `location`, `city`, `state`, `stateName` — where the business operates
- `county`, `zip`, `streetAddress` — only when the seller publishes them
- `industry`, `subIndustry` — BizQuest category and subcategory
- `listingType`, `listingTypeId` — established business, asset sale, startup, franchise, real estate and so on
- `isFranchise`, `isFranchiseResale`, `franchiseBrand`
- `adLevel` — BizQuest placement level
- `homeBased`, `absenteeOwner`, `relocatable`, `realEstateIncluded`
- `sellerFinancing` — whether the listing advertises seller financing

### Broker contact

- `brokerName`, `brokerCompany`
- `brokerPhone`, `brokerPhoneAlt`
- `brokerProfileUrl`, `brokerProfileId`, `brokerPhoto`
- `brokerLicense`, `isLicenseVerified` — when the detail page shows them

### Full details (when `fetchDetails` is on)

- `description` — the seller's complete write-up
- `reasonForSelling`, `facilities`, `support`, `financingOptions`, `competition`, `growth`, `leaseTerms`, `currentAndPriorUse`
- `yearEstablished`, `yearsInOperation`, `employees`, `fullTimeEmployees`, `partTimeEmployees`
- `inventoryValue`, `ffeValue`, `realEstateValue`, `buildingSqft`, `multipleEbitda`, `multipleSde`, `netOperatingIncome`, `ownersComp`, `preTaxNetIncome`
- `initialFee`, `initialCapital` — franchise fees when published
- `photos`, `thumbnail` — image URLs from BizQuest's CDN
- `hotProperty`, `recentlyAdded`, `recentlyUpdated`, `profileViews`, `equipmentInAsking`, `isLicenseVerified`

### Run metadata

- `scrapedAt` — ISO-8601 UTC timestamp
- `searchUrl`, `page`, `position`, `totalListings` — where the row came from

### Error rows

If a URL cannot be fetched or parsed, the run emits `{ "inputUrl", "error", "scrapedAt" }` for that URL instead of failing the whole run.

## Use cases

- **Acquisition sourcing** — build a pipeline of businesses that match your target price, cash flow and state
- **Market sizing** — count active listings by industry, state, listing type or price band
- **Broker and franchise research** — see which brokers or franchise brands are actively listing
- **Financial screening** — filter by asking price, cash flow or gross revenue, then pull full financials
- **Monitoring** — schedule the actor and compare `listingId` sets to spot new, removed or price-reduced listings

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with BizQuest?** No. This is an independent data extraction tool and is not endorsed by or affiliated with BizQuest.

**Do I need a BizQuest account, cookie or API key?** No. The actor reads public listings and runs without credentials.

**Why do some financial fields appear empty?** Sellers can hide cash flow, EBITDA or revenue. The actor never invents a figure: when BizQuest does not publish a value, the field is absent from that row.

**Why does `fetchDetails` cost more time?** Each listing's detail page is a separate request. The search-only mode is enough for price, location, industry and broker contact; enable details only when you need the seller write-up, full financials or photo gallery.

**How many listings can I get?** BizQuest exposes up to 10,000 listings per search. Narrow the search by state, industry, price or listing type to partition a very broad query.

**Can I filter by city or county?** Yes — apply the city or county filter on BizQuest.com and paste the resulting URL into `startUrls`. The `state` field covers state-level filtering.

**Why are some photos not visible in my browser?** Photo URLs point at BizQuest's image CDN, which may apply hotlink protection. The URLs are the original public image paths; open them with the listing page as the referrer if your browser blocks them.

**Why is a street address missing?** Many sellers list confidentially. BizQuest suppresses the exact address; city, state and ZIP are returned when published.

**Can I track new listings on a schedule?** Yes. Run the actor on a schedule and compare `listingId` values between runs, or use the `listedWithinDays` and `recentlyUpdated` filters.

**What if a run returns zero listings?** A narrow filter combination may genuinely have no matches. Broaden the price range, remove the keyword, or choose a wider location and try again.

## Data source and limitations

- Public BizQuest business-for-sale listings, read without cookies or a login.
- 10,000-listing ceiling per search, set by BizQuest.
- Cash flow, EBITDA and revenue are only present when the seller discloses them.
- Some detail fields (reason for selling, facilities, financing) are seller-provided and may be absent.
- Broker emails are not extracted; only publicly shown names, companies, phones, profile links and photos are returned.
- Photo and broker-image URLs are BizQuest CDN links and may be hotlink-protected.
- A proxy is optional. Use one only if your own runs are rate-limited.
